- Repository consists of a single notebook converted to a script: [/kaggle/titanic-tree-models-multi-layer-perceptron/titanic-tree-models-multi-layer-perceptron.py:339-461]. The MLP definition and training loop are implemented there, including the printed training loss lines.

- Instrumentation patches applied to enable the tiny-batch overfit test and compatibility with current sklearn, and to reduce I/O overhead (saved as patched script): [/evidence/artifacts/patched_titanic_mlp.py:344-364] restricts training to a tiny subset (TINY_N=16) before MLP; [/evidence/artifacts/patched_titanic_mlp.py:402-408] sets full-batch training on the tiny subset; [/evidence/artifacts/patched_titanic_mlp.py:425-436] adds early-stopping condition; [/evidence/artifacts/patched_titanic_mlp.py:447-458] reduces per-epoch logging/output.
